modern: Consider yourself to be dead, and to have completed your life up to the present time; and live the remainder which is allowed you in keeping with nature.
original: Consider thyself to be dead, and to have completed thy life up to the present time; and live according to nature the remainder which is allowed thee.
notification: Consider yourself to be dead, and to have completed your life up to the present time; and live the remainder which is allowed you in keeping with nature.

explained.summary: Imagine you have already died and your life is complete up to now. Whatever time is left is a bonus, so live it in line with nature. Marcus uses the thought of death to clear away regret and anxiety and make the remainder count.
explained.today: Treating today as extra time can change how you spend it: less fretting over the email you sent badly yesterday, more attention to the person across the table.
